class.name: ItemTouchHelper
class.description:
ItemTouchHelper is the port of [i]androidx.recyclerview.widget.ItemTouchHelper[/i]. It adds long-press drag-to-reorder and swipe-to-dismiss to a RecyclerView. Create it, attach a [b]ItemTouchHelperCallback[/b] subclass, then call [method attach_to_recycler_view]:
[codeblock] var helper := ItemTouchHelper.new() helper.set_callback(MyCallback.new()) helper.attach_to_recycler_view(recycler_view) [/codeblock]
During a gesture the helper intercepts the RecyclerView's input before scrolling, pins the selected holder's Control under the finger (the translation model), and on release either snaps it back (drag cancel / failed swipe) or commits the move / swipe via the callback's [method ItemTouchHelperCallback._on_move] / [method ItemTouchHelperCallback._on_swiped].

method.name: attach_to_recycler_view
method.description: Attaches the helper to a RecyclerView (internally calls [method RecyclerView.set_item_touch_helper]).

method.name: detach
method.description: Detaches the helper from its RecyclerView.

method.name: get_action_state
method.description: Returns the current action state: [constant ACTION_STATE_IDLE], [constant ACTION_STATE_SWIPE] or [constant ACTION_STATE_DRAG].

method.name: get_selected_holder
method.description: Returns the holder currently being dragged / swiped, or an invalid Ref when none.

method.name: is_dragging
method.description: Returns whether a drag is in progress.

method.name: is_occupied
method.description: Returns whether the holder is being dragged / swiped or animating back; such holders are excluded from item animations.

method.name: make_movement_flags
method.description: Static helper that packs [code]drag_flags[/code] and [code]swipe_flags[/code] direction bits into the movement-flags int returned by [method ItemTouchHelperCallback._get_movement_flags].

method.name: set_callback
method.description: Sets the [b]ItemTouchHelperCallback[/b] that declares movement flags and handles move / swipe commits.

method.name: set_long_press_timeout
method.description: Sets the long-press timeout in milliseconds (default 0.4s) before a drag starts.
